topic: The Magic of Light: Principles of Diffraction and Holography

sections.title: Prerequisite: Wave Superposition
lecture_lines: Light waves superimpose when they meet.
Imagine ripples in a quiet pond.
animations: Draw two sine waves in #FFFFFF, labeled Wave_1 and Wave_2.
Animate Wave_1 and Wave_2 moving toward each other.

sections.title: Diffraction: Light Bending Around Obstacles
animations: Show a plane wave in #FFFFFF hitting a narrow aperture.
Animate wave bending around edges to form curved fronts.
Label the bending effect as Diffraction in #FF00FF.

sections.title: Holography: Encoding the Phase
lecture_lines: It uses reference and object beams.
animations: Animate interference on the recording plate, #FFFFFF.
Render the resulting fringe pattern clearly.
Fade out beams, leaving the hologram grid in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Reconstruction: Decoding the 3D Image
animations: Show monochromatic laser light hitting the hologram #FFFFFF.
Animate the reconstruction of the original object wavefront.
Visualize the light rays projecting the object in 3D.

sections.title: Summary and Real-world Application
animations: Flash the key concepts: Superposition, Diffraction, Phase #FFFFFF.
Animate the progression from plate to reconstruction.
Show final application examples labeled in #FF00FF.
